metadata.description: GitHub OSS repository metadata for Founder Fade hypothesis testing. Contains repo-level features and proxy survival labels (ACTIVE/INACTIVE). (demo subset of 50 examples)
source_datasets: h1alexbel/github-repos (14,428 repos, MIT license, collected via ghminer tool)
metadata.selection_rationale: Chosen over AmanPriyanshu/random-small-github-repositories due to: (1) larger coverage (14K vs 5.6K repos), (2) richer features (contributors, commits, pulls, issues, forks, stars, language, dates), (3) broader ecosystem (not limited to Android/Java), (4) confirmed provenance via ghminer GitHub repo.
metadata.label_definition: ACTIVE if contributors>=5 OR (stars>=1000 AND activity_ratio>=0.5); INACTIVE if contributors<=2 AND activity_ratio<0.1. Proxy labels for downstream Founder Fade analysis.
